  • NOT MERGED. Main's CI is red on the runner change, so PR 498 can't merge on a green head, and the email's image links point at the run branch.
  • SOCIAL DELIVERY BLOCKED. It runs only after the merge, so nothing was published to the brand accounts today.
  • The deck shipped at the round cap, 7.378 against the 8.0 bar, art median 7.4 under the 8.5 craft floor.
  • Frames 7 and 8 were retuned after round 3 scored them so the dusk gold accent measured on three frames, and the deck was not scored again.
  • Host effort was medium, not the high the settings carry, for the fourth run in a row.

Named here rather than left out. A run that quietly ships less than it planned teaches nobody anything.

Publication assets

These are the deck and copy retained for the automatic publishing workflow. Social delivery status comes from the destination receipts, not from the deck's merge or score. Do not manually repost a destination that already has a successful receipt.

carousel.pdf   contact sheet   the site

1. The post copy

One written answer on a STAAR reading test.

Since December 2023 a Texas Education Agency scoring engine has read the written answers on English STAAR tests first. Its design then sent at least 25 percent to people too. Their score counted. TEA says hand scoring would cost $15 million to $20 million more a year.

Then districts asked for a person. Reading rescore requests rose from 2,758 in spring 2024 to 64,489 this spring, the Texas Tribune reported October 7th. People did every rescore. More than 13,300 scores went up. In Dallas ISD 34% of more than 5,100 tests came back higher.

Fewer than half of one percent of all open-ended reading answers changed.

A rescore costs a district $50 a test unless the score changes.

TEA's design dates to December 2023 and March 2024. Does it still describe this spring's scoring?

#STAAR #TexasEducationAgency #DallasISD

The machine changed itself

  • depth_floor counts a TXT.studio sweep as a ground
    it refused studio frames as ungrounded although the sweep is the floor
  • Questions page builds on a day with no open comment window (feeds.py)
    its refusal broke the gridwatch rebuild and removed 807 docs files from main
  • Machine queue: render report clobbering, fig_inject string literals, accent floor before the panel, level camera ground vertex, chassis bugs
    each cost this run a round or a rebuild

Every change is logged in ledger/carousel/upgrades.json.

Notes

TO CLEAR THE MERGE: set runs-on: ubuntu-24.04 in .github/workflows/guards.yml (or bump Playwright in package.json). Then CI can go green on PR 498 and PR 497, and PR 498 can merge. PR 498 also carries the site rebuild that restores the grid, water and source pages the gridwatch run deleted at 02:25 UTC. The record. 153 URLs re-verified, 21 items stamped, tx-2026-0072 and tx-2026-0075 re-verified by hand. tx-2026-0194 gained the Tribune's spring rescore counts, tx-2026-0182 gained TCEQ's permit review resuming, and tx-2026-0250 (TACC Horizon, Williamson County) was admitted. PUCT filing lists for 0003 and 0076 drop older filings, so those stay unstamped. The deck. TEA's scoring engine reads English STAAR written answers first, and reading rescore requests went from 2,758 in spring 2024 to 64,489 this spring. Three panel rounds scored 7.26, 7.336 and 7.378, with no hard fail. The integrity judges cut a ratio the sources don't support (one in five raised) and a cost cited to a spokesperson when TEA's own document says the same, and both were fixed. The cover took three changes of representation before the art director accepted it. The 2026 counts rest on one Tribune report because TEA's pages answered 404, and the deck says so. Prompt audit, the reading that counts. 2413 tool calls measured, 72 over the waiting threshold, all Agent and SendMessage calls at 7 to 25 seconds plus Bash under 8 seconds, the latency shape already queued. No-stall hook armed at 05:07:15 UTC, judged the session unattended (CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ATTENDED=0 from the host), refused nothing.

This email is a draft. Nothing was sent by email. The deck did NOT merge, so nothing here is on main and there is nothing to post. The links resolve against the run branch for as long as it exists.
